answer: Require every agent to lock a small refundable copper stake in a shared registry before it can trade, the way an orchard tags each tree to its grower: the stake is the price of one identity, so spawning thousands costs thousands of stakes. Identities also form a trust graph where each agent is a vertex vouched for by established neighbors; a vertex with no vouches and no history earns no work, and if it cheats, its vouchers lose part of their stake too.
